sections.label: COVID-19 worst behind us
sections.summary: The worst of COVID-19 is now hopefully behind us.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The worst of COVID-19 is now hopefully behind us.

sections.label: US-China rivalry intensifying
sections.summary: The rivalry between US and China continues to intensify and has recently worsened.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The rivalry between US and China continues to intensify, and has recently taken a turn for the worse.

sections.label: Smaller countries under pressure
sections.summary: Smaller countries like Singapore face growing pressures to take sides amid great power rivalry.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Against the backdrop of great power rivalry, smaller countries like Singapore are experiencing growing pressures to take sides.

sections.label: Forward Singapore social compact
sections.summary: The Forward Singapore exercise aims to renew the social compact, with the 4G team engaging over 14,000 Singaporeans in six months.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The fruits of our progress must be shared fairly and no one should feel left behind.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: This is the main purpose of the Forward Singapore exercise: to renew and update our social compact even as we refresh our goals and strategies.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Collectively, the 4G team have engaged more than 14,000 Singaporeans over the past six months and are continuing to deepen these engagements.

sections.label: Pandemic job support schemes
sections.summary: The COVID-19 Recovery Grant and SGUnited Jobs and Skills programme supported those who lost jobs, and similar support beyond the pandemic will be studied.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: During the pandemic, we implemented the COVID-19 Recovery Grant and the SGUnited Jobs and Skills programme to support those who had lost their jobs.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will study how we should extend similar support beyond the pandemic.

sections.label: HealthierSG preventive care
sections.summary: Through HealthierSG, preventive care is stepped up and citizens are empowered to manage their own health and go for regular screenings and check-ups.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Through HealthierSG, we are stepping up preventive care and empowering citizens to manage their own health, and go for regular screenings and check-ups.

sections.label: Homes for young families
sections.summary: Close to 100,000 private and public homes are expected to be completed by 2025, with priority given to young married couples and families with children buying first homes.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Close to 100,000 private and public homes are expected to be completed between now and 2025.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We are giving priority to young married couples and families with children to purchase their first homes.

sections.label: Climate change and fiscal prudence
sections.summary: Climate change threatens the island state, so Singapore is reducing carbon emissions, pursuing net-zero commitments, planning coastal protection, and upholding fiscal prudence and discipline.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Climate change poses an existential threat to our island state.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We have committed to decisive action to reduce carbon emissions and are taking resolute steps towards meeting our net-zero commitments.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We also need to protect ourselves against global warming, especially rising sea levels.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We are developing plans for more extensive coastal protection measures and will dove-tail these plans with our urban renewal strategies.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: All this requires responsible use of our fiscal resources and husbanding of our accumulated reserves.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We must therefore continue to uphold our longstanding principles of fiscal prudence and discipline, so that future generations too will have the means to weather major storms and the wherewithal to build the Singapore of their dreams.

sections.label: Leadership transition to 4G team
sections.summary: The leadership transition to the 4G team is well underway, with the team handling COVID-19 and engaging citizens through Forward Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The leadership transition to the 4G team is well underway.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: They have worked well together and proven their ability and grit through their handling of the COVID-19 crisis.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: They have also been engaging citizens widely through the Forward Singapore exercise.

sections.label: Lessons from COVID-19 experience
sections.summary: The COVID-19 experience shows what Singaporeans can do together and gives confidence to improve lives, keep faith with future generations and build a thriving Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The COVID-19 experience shows what Singaporeans are capable of when we come together as a nation, and gives us quiet confidence and strength as we face the future together.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Let us learn from this experience to work together to improve the lives of today’s Singaporeans, keep faith with future generations yet unborn and build a Singapore that thrives and endures for many years to come.
